correctness.rationale: For all n>=0 the recurrence yields K^n v. Four Mahler expansions have exact first and second coefficient valuations, and higher coefficients are strictly smaller after binomial-difference valuation comparison. Therefore their images are exactly four specified two-adic disks. Parity and the exceptional branch coefficients c0..c3, with D6 divisible by four, exclude everything outside their three-disk union. The cardinality formula follows by disjoint projection. VERIFY.py confirms all required finite matrix coefficients and moduli through 2^13. The proof is infinite and independent of finite enumeration.

value.rationale: The natural question which dyadic residue values occur in the Pell–Narayana sequence is not answered by its known periods. The exact three-ball criterion, sharp exceptional modulus 256 and Haar measure 161/256 furnish a complete local classification valid for every exponent, with explicit infinite families for each allowed residue. This goes beyond a finite table, a trivial special case of a known period formula, or a mere reparametrization.
